content:
pagerduty-bot: SEV2 pager: model-serving runtime errors increased in us-east-1. Alert group: model-runner-5xx. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: saw it, joining. what metrics?

inc_bot: Root alert: gateway 5xx rate spike on /v1/generate (us-east-1) -> 11.7% across 30s. Upstream model-runner crashes reported: OOMs and SIGSEGV.

alex: i'm on logs. grep shows repeated `RuntimeError: double free` and kernel OOM messages on host gpu-node-12.*

jamie: copying a sample from gpu logs:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:04Z] model-runner[pid=4821]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f3b... rflags=0x...
[2026-03-15T09:12:05Z] kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4821 (model-runner) score 987
```

patricia: which model variant? any pattern (seq len, batching)?

alex: appears concentrated on redwood-small-v1-quant and redwood-medium-v1-q4_0 when sequence >1024 and batch_size>=8.  CPU and GPU memory graphs show spikes right before crash.

jamie: initial mitigation proposal: 1) route traffic off the affected model variants to fallback models 2) reduce max_batch_size for realtime routes 3) drain and reboot affected hosts 4) enable fallback policy to cpu-backed instances for small requests.

sre-oncall: take the routing change now. I’ll run the routing command.

infra: noted, prepping node drain playbook for gpu-node-12..gpu-node-16.

alex: routing command (run in ops cli):
```
opsctl routing set-policy --prefix /v1/generate --region us-east-1 --fallback redwood-small-v1 --percent 100
```

jamie: applied reduced batch policy (temporary): max_batch_size=4 for realtime routes. Confirming telemetry...

inc_bot: routing change applied, new policy shows fallback at 100% for /v1/generate in us-east-1. Batch override applied.

sre-oncall: monitoring. error rate falling from 11.7% -> 3.2% in last 90s. Keep watching.

cs-esc: which customers hit? any Dedicated tenants affected? Need to notify.

alex: early list from request logs: MalloryHealth (dedicated-us-east), EduDocs (hosted but high qps), internal-integrations (canary traffic saw failures). I'm escalating MalloryHealth to account team.

patricia: starting host drain: ssh to gpu-node-12, stop model-runner, move running inferences to fallback nodes. command:
```
ssh ops@gpu-node-12 sudo systemctl stop model-runner && opsctl node drain gpu-node-12
```

infra: drain in progress on gpu-node-12..14. gpu-node-15 had a dirty kernel oom, we need a cold reboot. scheduling now.

jamie: discovered crash signature: `quant_kernels::gemm` stack trace in the logs -> indicates a quantized kernel edge-case in the new fused-kernel path. Patch exists in upstream runtime branch `fix/quant-gemm-safety`. We should avoid deploying that path and pin kernel selection to safe path while we patch.

sre-oncall: set kernel-selection to conservative for affected models. opsctl command:
```
opsctl runtime config set --model redwood-small-v1-quant --kernel-path safe
```

inc_bot: kernel selection pinned for 5 models. Telemetry: 5xx now 0.9% and trending down.

alex: after draining and pinning, a few hosts still report OOMs during restart. infra to investigate kernel logs and dmesg.

infra: confirmed on gpu-node-15: vendor driver OOM on cudaMemcpy -> possible memory leak with newly compiled kernel. Will gather `dmesg` and driver logs and escalate to runtime-ml team.

patricia: customer-facing note draft: "We detected an elevated error rate affecting inference requests in us-east-1 between 09:12-09:30 UTC. Traffic has been routed to fallback model variants and affected nodes have been drained. Some Dedicated customers (MalloryHealth) experienced degraded responses; we are contacting them directly." Review?

cs-esc: message OK. add 'we will follow up with root cause and mitigations' and include timeline. send now.

sre-oncall: quick status update: mitigation actions applied: routing fallback, batch size reduced, kernel path pinned, 5 hosts drained/rebooted. System-wide 5xx back to baseline ~0.15%.

jamie: next steps: runtime-ml to merge hotfix for quant-gemm-safety; infra to validate driver memory accounting on affected instance types; ops to run canary with new kernel on staging. Patch PR referenced: GH#8912.

alex: I'll take the postmortem ownership. adding notes: timeline, impact list, mitigation commands, and PR link.

inc_bot: Pager duty incident state changed: Active -> Mitigated.

patricia: handing off to next oncall for monitoring through the 2hr window. @jamie, @alex please post rollback/forward plan in the incident doc.

sre-oncall: handing off. Oncall now: alex (primary), jamie (secondary).

alex: ack. I'll keep an eye for regressions and coordinate the hotfix rollout.

cs-esc: MalloryHealth support ticket created (#MH-321). Account team alerted.

infra: collecting kernels/drivers logs and creating archive: /var/archives/incident-2926000000.tar.gz

jamie: quick note for postmortem: root cause likely a combination of new quantized kernel selection + high batch/long seq leading to unbounded memory allocation path. Hardening: limit batch by model-config, add watchdog on kernel allocations, and add canary that exercises long sequences.

alex: thanks all. I'll open the postmortem and link this thread. closing channel thread for active mitigation but will update with RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
